# Quantum Sensing Without Bath Resets

> Local-uniform frequency-estimation risk for a known finite joint Lindblad model with a probe-only signal and a persistent, unreset environment.

The initial environment state is arbitrary and unknown. The model matrices are known. The calibration interval is fixed and local. The general protocol has a sufficient O(N^3) ideal recovery/reset count, plus O(N) preparations and readouts; native logical-dephasing models admit fixed cadence. Read these assumptions with the theorem.

## Check the theorem and its limits

- [Model and results](science/model_and_results.md): Read the known-model, probe-only, fixed-local-interval and ideal-control assumptions first.
- [Control and resources](science/control_and_resources.md): Tagged recovery, logical dephasing, finite-channel approximation and complete-record risk transfer.
- [Finite-memory statistics](science/finite_memory_statistics.md): Stationary algebra, invisible noiseless factors, harmonic absorption, correlated-score variance and explicit local estimator.
- [Global ambiguity](science/global_ambiguity.md): A conserved hidden offset prevents wide-interval identification even under adaptive accessible controls.

## Reproduce and interpret the finite checks

- [Verification guide](verification/README.md): Commands, deterministic assertions, seeded diagnostics and their scope.
- [Examples](science/examples.md): Noncommuting unitary and dissipative baths, conserved sectors, noiseless factors, transient absorption and finite recovery.
- [Complete runner](verification/run_all.py): Runs the documented finite checks; the deterministic-only option overwrites default reports, as explained in the guide.
- [Sensing report](results/sensing_checks.json): Algebra, exact moments and trajectory results.
- [Control report](results/control_checks.json): Three-level conditional recovery and branch-basis checks.

## Follow attribution

- [Related work](references/related_work.md): Inherited ingredients, closest results, abstract-only comparison limits and distinction from the general plain prepare-and-measure conjecture.
- [Bibliography](references/references.bib): Structured source metadata, including the sole educational anchor.

The analytic proofs establish the general risk and diamond-norm bounds. Finite simulations support their tested identities and examples. The result does not optimize the recovery count or establish general performance with finite-duration noisy controls.
